slug.description: The camera this snapshot belongs to.

timestamp_ms.description: When the stored frame was captured, as a unix timestamp in milliseconds. `null` means nothing has been captured yet, which is an answer rather than an error.

age_ms.description: How old the stored frame is right now, in milliseconds; `null` when there is none. Snapshots are deliberately cheap and therefore deliberately old, and a cached frame served without its age is indistinguishable from a live one.

width.description: Width of the stored frame in pixels, or `null` when nothing has been captured yet.

height.description: Height of the stored frame in pixels, or `null` when nothing has been captured yet.

mime.description: The media type of the stored frame, such as `image/jpeg`, or `null` when nothing has been captured yet.
